rules: Source and retrieval dates identify reference origin, not the freshness of protocol state. Read dynamic values and updates on demand for current claims or report unavailable; retained observations may be reused with their historical as-of time and provenance, not relabelled as current.
Use original source URLs and record scope. Exact canonical parameters live in assets/parameters.json.

Unavailable or unresolved implementation details remain not-established. Requested hypothetical scenarios may use explicit user assumptions or estimates, kept separate from facts; never invent evidence to fill a gap.
